productTitle: European Banker's Lamp — Old Shanghai Green Glass Vintage Office Desk Lamp
authoredBy: in-chat scene design — iconic banker's lamp with emerald-green glass shade, antique brass base and pull-chain; 5 variants (antique green / electroplated gold / etc.) cycled 1-5 then slot 6 repeats variant 1; warm white 2700-3000K per the warm amber glow through green glass

Walls are deep oxblood-burgundy mahogany panelling with a single oil-rubbed bronze sconce above. The lamp matches the reference image exactly — wide emerald-green glass canopy shade in the colour shown in the reference, antique-brass turned column base and pull-chain — switched ON, warm white 2700-3000K (matches the warm amber glow visible through the green glass in the variant reference). Palette of mahogany, oxblood leather, emerald green, antique brass, ivory. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
